meta.label: Filipino
meta.note: Machine-translated by Claude, not a dedicated MT engine, and not yet checked by a native Filipino speaker. Official document names (birth certificate, business permit, real property tax) keep the English term alongside the translation on purpose, so a reader matching this against a physical form or requirement list still recognizes it. A report link is shown on every page using this file until meta.reviewed is true.
